expected_value_creation: Make escalation resolution and operational responsiveness traceable and reproducible without turning speed, volume, or disposition into quality.
beneficiary: QIF evaluators, accountable reviewers, domain specialists, operators, and affected stakeholders
supporting_evidence: QIF v0.6.35 already separates route recommendation, actual execution, authority, and outcome.
Anthropic reports review latency and escalation disposition as distinct oversight measures; NIST recommends documenting response time and response type.
success_criteria: Every resolution traces to a governed selective escalation decision and route.
The verifier reproduces elapsed time, response-time conformance, disposition, availability, evidence state, and governance triggers.
Response time, resolution count, and throughput are explicitly bounded as operational evidence rather than quality or competence.
